seo.title: Protection Solutions
seo.description: Complete protection, better comfort and a greener future — IrisPro protection solutions for automotive, residential, commercial, personal protection and sustainability, engineered for ASEAN climate.

data.subhead: IrisPro provides advanced protection solutions for people, properties and the planet — engineered for the intense sun and unique climate of ASEAN.

media.alt: Triptych composition: a premium car on the road, a modern residence, and a glass commercial tower under bright ASEAN sun — one protection technology across all three.
